name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: copywriting_optimization
prompts.template: Improve the following marketing copy for better conversion and clarity: {content_data}
prompts.use_case: Enhancing website and landing page conversion rates.

prompts.name: seo_keyword_analysis
prompts.template: Analyze and suggest improvements for SEO using the keywords: {seo_keywords}
prompts.use_case: Generating compelling marketing copy for campaigns.

prompts.name: growth_strategy_recommendation
prompts.template: Based on the following analytics data, suggest a growth strategy: {analytics_data}
prompts.use_case: Optimizing content for search engine rankings.

prompts.name: conversion_rate_insights
prompts.template: Provide insights and recommendations to improve conversion rates for the marketing goal: {marketing_goal}
prompts.use_case: Analyzing campaign analytics to identify growth opportunities.
